name: manual_72b17d
claim: A helper that lives only in a session scratchpad is lost when the scratchpad is cleared. When a script has been used for a recurring task more than once, promote it into the repository with tests and docs and name it in the skill that owns the task (here lan_peer_send.py, orama PR 491).

decisions.notes: The ad hoc send helper vanished with the scratchpad mid-session and had to be rebuilt.

rationale: The ad hoc send helper vanished with the scratchpad mid-session and had to be rebuilt.
